records.text: Vile Familiars serve the Burning Blade coven in the Valley of Trials and have spilled from its cave to cause havoc. They use Fireball in combat.
Felstalkers are demons whose hooves Canaga Earthcaller asks aspiring shamans to collect for a trial of earth.
A Makrura Clacker may flee for assistance when badly wounded.
A Makrura Shellhide that flees for help when badly wounded.
A Makrura Snapclaw that casts Claw Grasp in combat and flees for help when badly wounded.
A Pygmy Surf Crawler that flees for help when badly wounded.
A Surf Crawler is a beast that may flee for assistance when badly wounded.
An Encrusted Surf Crawler can use Quick Sidestep in combat.
A Dreadmaw Crocolisk can use Muscle Tear in combat.
Razormane quilboars hold fortified camps in Durotar. Gar’Thok seeks to drive them out, regarding their presence as a threat. They use Razor Mane.
Razormane Scouts belong to the fortified quilboar forces Gar’Thok seeks to drive from Durotar. They shoot at opponents in combat.
Razormane Dustrunners belong to the fortified quilboar forces Gar’Thok seeks to drive from Durotar. They can cast Faerie Fire in combat.
Razormane Battleguards belong to the fortified quilboar forces Gar’Thok seeks to drive from Durotar. They use Improved Blocking in combat.
A Dustwind Harpy may flee for assistance when badly wounded.
A Dustwind Pillager uses Rend Flesh in combat.
Dustwind Savages are harpies Rezlak wants cleared from Drygulch Ravine to protect caravan routes. A badly wounded Savage may flee for assistance.
Dustwind Storm Witches are harpies Rezlak wants driven from the caravan routes through Drygulch Ravine. They can cast Lightning Bolt in combat.
A Kolkar Drudge can use Dust Cloud in combat.
A Kolkar Outrunner uses Shoot in combat and flees for assistance when badly wounded.
A Durotar Tiger is a wild feline.
A Bloodtalon Taillasher can use Rushing Charge when entering combat.
A Bloodtalon Scythemaw can use Rushing Charge when entering combat.
A Scorpid Worker can use Weak Poison in combat.
A Clattering Scorpid can use Poison in combat.
An Armored Scorpid is a scorpid beast.
A Venomtail Scorpid can use Venom Sting in combat.
A Kul Tiras human sailor among the force the Horde seeks to drive from Durotar. The Horde's account says Lieutenant Benedict's force retook Tiragarde Keep, renewing the threat to the homeland.
The marine warns others away from a lieutenant’s belongings, showing a local guarding concern.
A Thunder Lizard can use Lizard Bolt in combat.
A Lightning Hide can use Lizard Bolt in combat.
Gar'Thok commands Razor Hill's defense against renewed Kul Tiras aggression. He studies Alliance tools to understand the enemies threatening Durotar.
Lar Prowltusk is a Durotar scout who discovered a three-part Kolkar attack plan against the trolls and orcs. He recruits help to disrupt the planned invasion.
A Makrura Elder can use Claw Grasp in combat.
Orgnil Soulscar is an orc investigating the Burning Blade's activity in Durotar. He identifies the warlock Fizzle Darkstorm as a threat and directs a hunt for him.
Gornek is a local guide for new recruits. He directs them to test themselves against mottled boars, then report back to him at the Den.

Zureetha Fargaze was sent to guide the Valley of Trials, where she discovered a Burning Blade coven and its spreading taint. She directs the fight against its familiars and seeks the coven's medallion, speaking with the purpose of a diviner and field guide.

Age has ended Furl Scornbrow's usefulness in battle, so he watches for invaders and makes goods to help younger defenders. He is practical and helpful, offering to fashion a bag for someone who brings canvas.
Frang is a warrior trainer who offers information about Dual Talent Specialization.
Jen'shan is a hunter trainer who trains hunters and discusses talent unlearning and dual talent specialization.
Rwag trains rogues and voices confidence that the Shattered Hand can restore the Horde despite the Warchief's timidity.
Nartok trains warlocks, warning that command of dangerous forces requires a strong will.
Shikrik is a shaman trainer whose teaching is framed around guidance from the spirits.
Duokna is a general-goods merchant who offers goods for browsing.
Kzan Thornslash is a weaponsmith who offers goods for sale.
Huklah sells cloth and leather armor.
Rarc is an armorer and shieldcrafter who offers goods for sale.
Uhgar is a weaponsmith who offers goods and repairs.
Jark is a general-goods vendor.
Ghrawt is a bowyer who offers goods and repairs.
Cutac is a cloth and leather armor merchant who offers goods to browse.
Wuark is an armorer and shieldcrafter who offers goods to browse.
Flakk handles trade supplies and offers goods to browse.
Tarshaw Jaggedscar is a warrior trainer who offers information about Dual Talent Specialization.
Kaplak trains rogues and says the Shattered Hand will restore the Horde’s former glory unhindered by a timid Warchief.
Thotar is a hunter trainer who teaches and guides young hunters in traditions passed down through generations.
Dhugru Gorelust is a warlock trainer who offers information about Dual Talent Specialization.
Swart is a shaman trainer who frames his service in terms of the spirits.
Dwukk trains blacksmiths and warns that anyone commenting about waterfowl will be eating through a tube.
Krunn trains those who want to learn mining.
Yarrog Baneshadow carries the Burning Blade Medallion sought by Zureetha Fargaze. Yarrog fights with Corruption and Immolate.
Miao'zan trains those who want to learn alchemy.
Mishiki is an herbalism trainer.
K'waii runs a general-goods shop where visitors can browse goods.
Tai'tasi runs a trade-supplies shop where visitors can browse goods.
Master Gadrin asks for reports of Burning Blade activity and seeks help freeing his brother Minshina, whose spirit Zalazane trapped in his skull.
Rhinag is a hunter who has fought nearby venomtails and speaks plainly about the danger they pose.
Cook Torka is a cook who prepares meals.
Lieutenant Benedict leads Admiral Proudmoore’s reserve force, which retook Tiragarde Keep. Gar’Thok regards the Kul Tiras force as a renewed threat to Durotar.
Misha is a worried mother whose son Kron went hunting and did not return. His stubborn pride has drawn him into danger before, and she fears for him.
Vel'rin balances her community's need for tiger hides against allowing the tigers to thrive. As needs grow, she sees a cull as necessary to provide materials for their goods.
A fighter associated with the Burning Blade.
A Burning Blade Neophyte can cast Immolate in combat.
A Burning Blade Fanatic fights among the Burning Blade ranks, using Fanatic Blade in combat.
A Burning Blade apprentice who summons a voidwalker and attacks with shadow bolts.
A Burning Blade cultist who summons an imp and attacks with fire magic.
Fizzle Darkstorm is a spellcaster who summons an imp and attacks with shadow magic.
Gazz’uz can cast Demon Skin.
Zalazane is a witchdoctor on the Echo Isles who sends his trolls to the mainland to hex their people and draw more under his sway. Gadrin describes those followers as former Darkspear trolls.
Voodoo Trolls are former Darkspear trolls under Zalazane’s sway. He sends his followers from the Echo Isles to hex their people. These trolls can cast Lightning Shield.
Hexed Trolls are former Darkspear trolls under Zalazane’s sway. He sends his followers from the Echo Isles to hex their people. These trolls can cast Immolate in combat.
Margoz is a shaman investigating the Searing Collars worn by Burning Blade cultists, seeking to uncover their demonic secrets. He admits that unlocking the collars’ secret is beyond his skills.
A corrupted mottled boar found in the Barrens region. It uses Corrupted Intellect during combat.
A corrupted scorpid found in the Barrens region. It uses Poison during combat.
A corrupted Bloodtalon Scythemaw appears in the Barrens region and uses Rushing Charge when it becomes aggressive.
A corrupted surf crawler found along the Barrens coast. It uses Decayed Strength during combat.
A corrupted Dreadmaw crocolisk found in the Barrens region. It uses Decayed Agility during combat.
Sarkoth is a named beast whose combat routine uses poison.

Hana'zua is a hunter who was badly wounded fighting a vicious scorpid while hunting in the Valley. Though weakened, he insists that his honor be upheld and asks for help against the beast; he knows they fought on the southern plateau.

Rezlak works for Gazlowe and was sent to aid the orcs in Durotar. Repeated caravan losses have made him determined to confront the harpy threat himself; his approach reflects Gazlowe's lessons to do a job well and to remember that anything can be done for a price.
Ophek knows Gan'rul Bloodeye through past dealings and regards the warlock's intentions as uncertain, possibly for good or ill.
A Sen'jin watcher in Durotar.
Master Vornal is an alchemist whose failing eyesight has led him to rely on alchemy to aid his magic. Wary of taking an apprentice, he tests a prospective student's confidence and worthiness.

Takrin Pathseeker recruits strong-seeming travelers for Barrens duty on behalf of his friend Kargal, whom he directs them to with a recruitment letter. He presents Horde service as a chance to do what is right.
Harruk trains hunters to teach their pets and says his help is only for hunters and their pets.
Tai'jin is a priest trainer who teaches students the priestly ways. She expects respect for her traditions and links priestly healing with blessings of the ancestors.
Ken'jai is a troll priest trainer who teaches the priestly ways and sends students to Tai'jin to learn more of their tribe's history and traditions.
Grimtak is a butcher who sells food and welcomes customers wishing to browse his goods.
Zlagk works as a butcher and sells food.
Hai’zan works as a butcher and sells food.
Holgar Stormaxe is a humanoid in Durotar.
A Sand Shark is a beast.
Ruzan directs novices to Zureetha Fargaze to help cull the cave creatures and asks them to report their work on the imp problem.
Warlord Kolkanis is rare and uses Thunderclap and Pummel in combat.
Watch Commander Zalaphil uses Defensive Stance outside combat and Shield Bash in combat.
Felweaver Scornn casts Shadow Bolt in combat and may flee for assistance when below 15% health.
Death Flayer uses Venom Sting in combat.
Captain Flat Tusk bears the title Captain of the Battleguard. He can adopt Battle Stance and uses Heroic Strike in combat.
Geolord Mottle maintains Lightning Shield outside combat and casts it on friendly units that lack the shield.

Un’Thu'wa is Sen’jin Village’s tribal mage and a mage trainer. He senses a disturbance in Durotar’s magic tied to Zalazane’s tainted ju-ju heaps, which corrupt wildlife and empower the land’s warlocks and infernals.
Mai’ah trains mages in the hidden arts and pities those whom Mai’ah considers unable to grasp the secrets of true magic.
Canaga Earthcaller guides shamans along the path of earth, teaching that its element can shape their destiny.
A minor manifestation of earth who offers a visitor rough quartz as proof of their meeting. It counsels patience, strength, wisdom, and respect for earth.
A minor fire manifestation associated with the Glowing Ember it leaves behind when defeated.

Telf Joolam instructs a fire totem initiate in making a fire sapta, requesting fire tar and a reagent pouch from Burning Blade cultists. He explains how sapta ingredients relate to fire and to the warlocks who carry the pouch. An associated task asks the learner to speak with him for another Fire Sapta.
Lau'Tiki trains fishing.
Zansoa is a vendor who supplies fishing goods.
Rawrk teaches First Aid and can refer experienced students to Doctor Gregory Victor at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.
A grunt in Durotar.
Razor Hill's grunt is associated with local directions to the bank, wind rider master, inn, and stable master.
Kitha is a humanoid found in Durotar.
Ula'elek is a Troll smith among the Darkspear. He crafts brutal gauntlets using the magic held in uncloven satyr hooves.
Rokar Bladeshadow presents himself as an old farmer when greeting a young visitor.
Harroc is a humanoid in Durotar.
Ukor is a peon who likes helping others.
Yelnagi Blackarm is a humanoid.
Grosk is an innkeeper who welcomes travelers to rest by the fire and share stories of their battles.

Zjolnir is a raptor handler who offers raptors as mounts and is involved in the ivory and red raptor replacement quests. He tells prospective buyers that his raptors are available only to those exalted with the Darkspear tribe.
Xar'Ti teaches Raptor Riding. Training requires payment and sufficient standing with the Darkspear trolls.
Frezza serves as a zeppelin master for the Tirisfal Glades-bound route, announcing arrivals and directing passengers toward Undercity.
Galgar is a local of the Valley of Trials who prizes cactus apples for a cooling treat he calls his famous cactus apple surprise. He knows the apples grow near the area's cactus plants.
Shoja'my is a stable master who helps travelers stable their pets and recover lost companions. The role centers on caring for traveling companions and helping their owners.
Kaltunk is a Horde recruiter who assesses newly adult recruits and directs them to Gornek for a suitable first task.
Trayexir is a weapon merchant who offers goods and ammunition and repairs equipment.
A lazy peon cries out in pain, then says they will get back to work.
Bom'bay is Gadrin's assistant and a witch-doctor student; he describes volunteer work as a way through school.
Raider Jhash and Raider Kerr act together: they let their wolves rest and drink, then charge into battle.
Kerr is a raider paired with Jhash on patrol; he follows Jhash.
Mukdrak is an Engineering Trainer who enjoys building things, especially blowing them up.
Foreman Thazz'ril complains that peons sleep on the job and asks for help waking them. He also seeks his favorite pick, left in a northern cave that he says is now filled with vicious beasts.
During Hallow's End, Kali Remik challenges trick-or-treaters to make a train noise in exchange for a Darkspear Gumdrop meant for a sick child.
Magga receives the Collector's Edition welcome voucher as part of the game's welcome service.

Snurk Bucksquick is a zeppelin master whose public call directs travelers to Grom'gol. In his travel patter, he jokes about Stranglethorn's tropical sun and complains that he is left in the heat with his brother Frezza.
An emerald riding raptor.
A turquoise riding raptor.
A violet riding raptor.
Grunt Kor'ja is grateful to the priest or priestess who helped him, saying the support gives him confidence to face humans. He also offers a farewell invoking the ancestors.
Hraug is a quest giver.
Makasgar is a humanoid in Durotar.
A Swift Orange Raptor.
A Swift Blue Raptor.

Javnir Nashak welcomes visitors during the Harvest Festival, offering fireworks and inviting them to remember the heroes whose sacrifices benefit Azeroth. He asks the Horde to honor Grom Hellscream for his strength and sacrifice.
An Honored Ancestor found in Durotar.
Elder Runetotem recalls days when hunting brought glory and honor, and wonders whether those old pursuits are so different from the present.
An Orgrimmar Reveler joins the festivities with jokes about the party and its fireworks.

This apprentice serves as a Voodoo Brew vendor for T'chali's brewery. The greeting is relaxed and colloquial, pitching the brew as the best in the realms. The same named vendor appears at several festival locations, tying the role to the traveling celebration.
Uta Roughdough is a bread vendor who offers goods to visitors.
Agnes Farwithers is a cheese vendor who offers goods to visitors.
Bron is a sausage vendor who lets visitors browse his goods.
The Suntouched Apprentice is a wine vendor who lets visitors browse goods.
A Brewfest reveler offers a complimentary sampler when waved to and answers a drinking gesture with a Brewfest toast.
A humanoid barker for Drohn's Distillery in Durotar.
A humanoid barker for T'chali's Voodoo Brewery in Durotar.
Blix Fixwidget is the Brewfest Token Redeemer. He handles the Brewfest Stein Voucher and other Brewfest transactions, and is described as strange, especially for his goggles.

Ram Master Ray oversees the racing-ram operation. He teases would-be racers that work comes before play, then gives them jobs proving their control of the rams or carrying kegs from a roadside crash to his assistant.
Cort Gorestein is a named quest giver.
Ja'ron is a named quest giver.
Driz Tumblequick is a Ram Racing Apprentice who invites visitors to learn about racing rams.
Bok Dropcertain is associated with keg throwing.

Glodrak Huntsniper presents himself as a dwarf working with Brewfest's beer gardens. He recruits visitors to handle pink-elekk and wolpertinger troubles, explaining that drunkenness or Synthebrew Goggles reveal the creatures. His concern for unsettled customers comes with an easy joke about drinking.
Tapper Swindlekeg is Brewfest's organizer, welcoming visitors and steering them toward festival drinks. His banter is cheerfully mercenary, with jokes about being an honest goblin.

Durotar Flame Keeper welcomes visitors to honor the flame, describing festival fires in Horde settlements as their own and urging desecration of Alliance fires. The keeper presents the festival from a Horde perspective.
An Arena Organizer serves as a petitioner for guild formation. Their available petition option points visitors toward information on how to form a guild.
Greeb Ramrocket serves travelers bound for Warsong Hold aboard The Mighty Wind, the zeppelin to Borean Tundra. Greeb announces its arrival and invites travelers aboard.
Bizzle Quicklift presents S.T.O.U.T. as a stein-throwing training target and encourages visitors to try it.
A Warsong Battleguard, a humanoid guard found in Durotar and Orgrimmar.
A cheerful orc spirit, glad to visit friends and family again and share stories of old.
A cheerful troll spirit, glad to visit friends and family again and share stories of old.
Francis Eaton is a Pilgrim's Bounty quest giver who receives pumpkin pie.
Dalni Tallgrass is a Pilgrim's Bounty vendor who offers goods for sale.
Ondani Greatmill is a cooking trainer who often gains students during Pilgrim’s Bounty. The feast’s heavy cooking workload can leave her short of dishes and ingredients.
Zelli Hotnozzle is the Thunder Bluff zeppelin master. Her goblin crew offers a direct ride between Orgrimmar and Thunder Bluff, an alternative to traveling by wyvern.
A ghostly orc celebrant glad to visit with friends and family again, celebrating and sharing stories of old.
A ghostly troll celebrant glad to visit with friends and family again, celebrating and sharing stories of old.
Bountiful Barrel is a Pilgrim's Bounty supplies vendor; its available interaction offers goods.
A Crown Supply Guard urges people to hurry packages along and mentions a delivery for the Lovely Merchant.
Vol’jin works with Vanira to organize the warriors opposing Zalazane.
Vanira invokes the tiger spirits for power and guidance, and says she was among the first to answer Vol’jin’s call to arms.
Handler Marnlek handles bats for the scouts.
A scout bat.
Champion Uru'zin trains new recruits for Vol'jin's forces.
A Darkspear witch doctor who leads communal rites and seeks guidance from the spirits.
A Ritual Dancer participates in ritual dancing.

This portrayal of Vol’jin anticipates retaking the Echo Isles for the Darkspear Tribe and declares that Zalazane’s time is running out. He asks for help reclaiming the islands and killing Zalazane. Vol’jin thanks a scout, orders patrols to continue and allows a rest before dismissing them.
A Darkspear Warrior serves as a fighter of the Darkspear.
A Darkspear scout reports that Zalazane has a large army planning something, with hexed trolls hidden beneath the canopy on the big island.

place_records.text: You are in Durotar, Horde land on the continent of Kalimdor. Razor Hill, Valley of Trials and Sen'jin Village are its main settlements, all held by the Horde. Scorpids roam the wilds, Kolkar centaurs gather over the ridge in Kolkar Crag, and Burning Blade cultists stir up trouble in the ridges and ravines. Kul Tiras soldiers have retaken Tiragarde Keep on the coast, which the Horde sees as a renewed threat to the land.

You are in Razor Hill, a Horde settlement in Durotar. Gar'Thok commands its defense against renewed Kul Tiras aggression, and Orgnil Soulscar is leading a hunt for the Burning Blade warlock Fizzle Darkstorm. Its inn and stable master serve travelers.

You are in Valley of Trials, a Horde settlement in Durotar. Zureetha Fargaze leads the fight against a Burning Blade coven and its spreading taint in the caves to the north, and Ruzan sends novices to help cull the cave creatures. Gornek sends newcomers to test themselves against mottled boars first.

You are in Kolkar Crag, where Kolkar centaurs gather just over the ridge west of Sen'jin Village. Kolkar drudges and outrunners roam the crag under Warlord Kolkanis. Lar Prowltusk has discovered their three-part attack plan against the trolls and orcs of Durotar.

You are in Sen'jin Village, a Horde settlement in Durotar kept by the Darkspear trolls. Un'Thuwa, its tribal mage, senses a disturbance in the land's magic from Zalazane's tainted ju-ju heaps, which corrupt wildlife and empower warlocks. Ula'elek, a Darkspear smith, crafts gauntlets from satyr hooves.

You are in Echo Isles, where the warlock Zalazane has placed tainted ju-ju heaps among his huts on the main isle. Hexed trolls and voodoo trolls are dangers here, along with makrura and Durotar tigers.

You are in Thunder Ridge, northwest of Razor Hill, where the Burning Blade warlock Fizzle Darkstorm has camped with his cultist minions. Burning Blade fanatics and apprentices spread chaos here, and thunder lizards and lightning hides roam the ridge.
You are in Drygulch Ravine, where Dustwind storm witches and savages roam alongside Burning Blade cultists and thugs. Armored scorpids are a danger here too.

You are in Tiragarde Keep, Alliance ground on the Durotar coast, retaken by Kul Tiras soldiers under Lieutenant Benedict. Sailors and marines hold it, and the Horde regards them as a renewed threat to Durotar. A marine warns others away from a lieutenant's belongings.
You are in Scuttle Coast, a shore where Kul Tiras sailors and marines are found alongside makrura. Makrura clackers, shellhides and elders, sand sharks and clattering scorpids are the dangers here.
You are in Bladefist Bay, a coast where surf crawlers live among makrura snapclaws and elders, sand sharks and corrupted surf crawlers. Venomtail scorpids and Bloodtalon scythemaws also come here.
You are in Deadeye Shore, a stretch of Durotar's coast where surf crawlers share the sand with makrura snapclaws, armored scorpids and sand sharks.
You are in Darkspear Strand, a shore where Lau'Tiki teaches fishing. Makrura clackers and shellhides, clattering scorpids and kolkar drudges are the dangers here, and Makasgar is a notable one.
You are in Razorwind Canyon, a stretch of Durotar. Dustwind harpies and Dustwind pillagers haunt the canyon, along with armored scorpids and Burning Blade neophytes.

You are in Spirit Rock, a neutral place in Durotar where earth spirits appear to visitors. A minor manifestation of earth hands out rough quartz to carry to Canaga Earthcaller in the Valley of Trials or to Seer Ravenfeather in Camp Narache. A Redrock Earth Spirit lingers here as well.

You are in Shrine of the Dormant Flame, a shrine in Durotar. Telf Joolam teaches fire totem initiates to make fire saptas, asking for fire tar and reagent pouches taken from Burning Blade cultists. A minor manifestation of fire waits at the top of the mountain, and its embers are placed in a brazier there.

You are in Southfury River, a stretch of Horde-held Durotar. Dreadmaw crocolisks are the chief danger along its banks, with venomtail scorpids, bloodtalon scythemaws and armored scorpids as well. Orgrimmar guards here can point visitors to the inn.

You are in Razormane Grounds, a Durotar area where Razormane quilboar, scouts, battleguards and dustrunners roam. Bloodtalon taillashers and armored scorpids are dangerous here too. Felstalkers wander the grounds, and aspiring shamans are sent to collect their hooves for Canaga Earthcaller.
You are in Skull Rock, a stretch of Durotar. Burning Blade fanatics and apprentices make it dangerous, along with bloodtalon scythemaws and venomtail scorpids. The felweaver Scornn is among them.

You are in Rocktusk Farm, a Horde farm near the northwestern border of Durotar. Rhinag, a hunter, has fought venomtail scorpids nearby and speaks plainly about the danger. A venomtail sting has left him weakened by poison.

You are in Jaggedswine Farm, a Horde farm in Durotar. Forsaken refugees who fled Undercity are here, homeless and frightened, and fear the Dark Lady may not have survived. A Warsong battleguard is also present, and venomtail and armored scorpids are nearby.

You are in Tor'kren Farm, a Horde farm in Durotar northwest of Razor Hill. Misha Tor'kren is a worried mother whose son Kron went hunting crocolisks along the Southfury River and has not come back. Armored scorpids and a corrupted bloodtalon scythemaw are nearby.

You are in The Den, a Horde settlement in Durotar. Gornek, a local guide for new recruits, sends them north after mottled boars and expects them to report back here. Rwag trains rogues, Nartok trains warlocks, Kzan Thornslash is a weaponsmith, Huklah sells cloth and leather armor, and Rarc is an armorer and shieldcrafter.

You are in Razor Hill Barracks, a Horde barracks in Durotar. Tarshaw Jaggedscar trains warriors, Swart trains shamans and frames his teaching in terms of the spirits, and Tai'jin teaches priests and expects respect for the ancestral ways. Rawrk teaches First Aid and can refer experienced students to Doctor Gregory Victor at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands. Jark sells general goods.
